title: Overwater Rescue
description: B-roll: A U.S. Air Force HH-60G Pave Hawk rescue helicopter assigned with the 55th Rescue Squadron, Davis Monthan Air Force Base, Arizona, lands at Moffett Air National Guarrd Base, California after returning from a long range over water search and rescue mission of an injured crewman on board a bulk container vessel, Ocean Applaud, August 28, 2020.
